skills, context injec"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"tion or port form work."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Editor setup (once per project)"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Your engine build must actually contain the `ModelContextProtocol` and `AllToolsets` plugins.
This p"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ackage does not install them, and does not claim support for every UE5 release. The exact
engine ver"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"sion/branch and Windows/Linux behavior have not yet been recorded as verified."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"1. Enable the `ModelContextProtocol` and `AllToolsets` plugins in the project's `.uproject`.
Without"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" `AllToolsets` the server starts but exposes no tools.
2. Start the MCP server when the editor runs:"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" either set `bAutoStartServer=True` under
`[/Script/ModelContextProtocolEngine.ModelContextProtocolS"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ettings]` in
`<Project>/Saved/Config/<Platform>Editor/EditorPerProjectUserSettings.ini`, or run
`Mod"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"elContextProtocol.StartServer [port]` in the editor console.
3. The default port is `8000`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Port configuration"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **Plugins page form (recommended).** Port and URL path are volatile config of the
`unreal-engine-s"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"kills` row. Saving goes through Harness settings (`settings.mutate` →
`configEditor.edit`); the host"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" half then synchronizes the `unreal-mcp` row's `url` to
`http://127.0.0.1:<port><path>` and the MCP "},{"id":"p21s4","text":"client reconnects, without a restart. The sync runs
both for a settings save (the Loader announces c"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ommitted volatile changes) and after a plugin
reload, and writes only when the url actually changes."},{"id":"p21s6","text":" It preserves current explicit settings
(including headers, timeouts and reconnect policy), with bun"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"dle defaults for fields that have not
been overridden (`failOnStartupError`, 300 s tool timeout, ~1 "},{"id":"p21s8","text":"h backoff reconnect budget). On a
Harness build that does not announce volatile updates, a saved end"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"point takes effect on the next
reload or restart.
- **Valid input.** Port must be an integer from 1 "},{"id":"p21s10","text":"to 65535. The path must start with `/`, contain
no spaces, backslashes, query or fragment, and use p"},{"id":"p21s11","text":"ercent encoding for characters outside the
RFC 3986 path set (for example `/mcp%20endpoint`). Both t"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"he form and host schema validate it.
- **Environment variable.** `UNREAL_MCP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:99"},{"id":"p21s13","text":"99/mcp` set before starting
Harness. It is process-wide (restart required) and always takes preceden"},{"id":"p21s14","text":"ce over the form.
- **Custom transport guard.** If you change the `unreal-mcp` row to a stdio proxy
"},{"id":"p21s15","text":"(`transport: stdio` with `command`/`args`), the port sync leaves that row untouched.
- **Patch entry"},{"id":"p21s16","text":" caveat.** In a profile patch, an entry with the same `id` *replaces* the row's
config instead of me"},{"id":"p21s17","text":"rging. A hand-written patch must repeat `serverName` / `transport` / `url`;
writing only `url` fails"},{"id":"p21s18","text":" schema validation and the plugin will not activate. Prefer the form or
the environment variable.
- "},{"id":"p21s19","text":"The sync relies on the HMR transaction around `configEditor.edit()`: it escapes the nested
transacti"},{"id":"p21s20","text":"on check with `hmr.executing.exit()` and runs on the HMR queue
